rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for working with others toward a shared goal.

example.english: We collaborate with several nearby schools to improve the reading programme.
example.traditional: 我哋同附近幾間學校合作，一齊搞好個閱讀計劃。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 tung4 fu6 gan6 gei2 gaan1 hok6 haau6 hap6 zok3 jat1 cai4 gaau2 hou2 go3 jyut6 duk6 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this specifically when the cooperation is treasonous and with an enemy or occupying force.

example.english: That interpreter actually chose to collaborate with the occupying forces and betray his own people.
example.traditional: 嗰個翻譯員竟然同佔領軍通敵，出賣自己人。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 faan1 jik6 jyun4 ging2 jin4 tung4 zim3 ling5 gwan1 tung1 dik6 ceot1 maai6 zi6 gei2 jan4
